title: KXTXR / Living Grimoire
self_description: KXTXR knows itself as an artistic experiment in emission, observation, residue, transformation and return.
objective: Observe whether an artistic signal can preserve identity and accumulate meaningful residue without allowing platform metrics to govern the next act.
primary_question: Which representation of QUE NO produces recognition and transmission without allowing platform metrics to govern authorship?

current_phase.name: QUE NO / REPRESENTATION
current_phase.purpose: Operate 07/12–12/12 as controlled representations: observe exposure, behavior and RETURN, then change at most one primary representation variable when evidence warrants it.
